title: com.docker.sandbox/agent-context@1
description: Written instruction content the agent reads. An explicit directory and filename select the agent profile; a workload filename alone is the legacy fallback. Tool mixins contribute contentFile or content alone (the two are mutually exclusive).

contentFile.description: Context-relative path in the authored descriptor; rewritten by the frontend to the staged in-image path in the published one.

content.description: Small instruction content inline, for content-free kits.

directory.description: Optional absolute, canonical in-sandbox profile directory; requires filename in the same entry. Omitted places the profile beside the workspace.
